sampling.always_kept: PAGER alert yellow/orange/red, or magnitude >= 6.0, or a holdout event
sampling.sampled: 1500 of the remaining 9064 green / no-alert events below M6.0, uniform random (seed 7), weight 6.043 each

ncei_join.rule: origin time within 60 s, epicentres within 100 km, magnitude within 0.3; nearest in time wins; each NCEI row used once
ncei_join.deaths_label: NCEI `deaths`, else `deathsTotal`; unmatched events = 0 (NCEI lists every earthquake that caused deaths)
ncei_join.injured_label: NCEI `injuries`, else `injuriesTotal`; unknown otherwise (row excluded from the injury model)

expocat.pagercat_join: PAGER-CAT eqID // 100 == EXPO-CAT eqID; PAGER-CAT minutes holding two events are skipped (67 rows)
expocat.deaths_rule: PAGER_prefShakingDeaths; 0 when both shaking and total deaths are blank (no source catalogue reported any); dropped when only total deaths are known

country.rule: EXPO-CAT ISO code where given; otherwise the Natural Earth 1:50m country containing the epicentre, or the nearest one within 500 km; otherwise PAGER's ccode
country.income_rule: World Bank OGHIST class for calendar-year data (event year - 1), clipped to 1987-2023; nearest listed year if that one is blank; countries not in OGHIST use today's API class
country.gdp_rule: World Bank NY.GDP.PCAP.CD for (event year - 1), nearest year within 10 years

sequences.rule: Gardner & Knopoff (1974) space-time windows (van Stiphout et al. 2012 fit), largest event first; foreshock side capped at 30 days

holdout_rule: events within 200 km and 30 days before to 365 days after each holdout mainshock, the listed ids, and anything grouped into the same sequence
